_: What the web app's first paint may cost, and what a raise means. THREE quantities: the JS entry graph, the ceiling on any one lazy chunk, and the render-blocking CSS — the last added at the M5 gate pass, when the performance review found it measured in the report and read by nothing, under a docblock claiming to cover everything the browser parses first. See apps/web/scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs. A raise carries a one-line reason in `raisedBecause` — a budget quietly moved up is a budget that never says no.
measuredBy: pnpm exec vite build in apps/web (writes bundle-report.json), run against origin/main's apps/web/src at a841768f — the floor is what main costs, never what a branch costs, or the branch under test sets its own bar.

floor._: The measurement the budget is derived from, kept so a later reader can see how much headroom has been spent without re-running the build. RE-FLOORED 2026-09-25 on the product owner's instruction, replacing the 2026-09-16 measurement of 425798 / 128582 / 15433, which is recorded here because `check-bundle-size.mjs` B7 reads a fixed key set and a `previousFloor` key would fail the gate. The entry graph grew 425798 → 445254 (+19.00 kB) in nine days across the NetPoint, layout-interchange and link-routing epics, none of which added a package: the headroom was spent as designed, on ordinary features.

headroomRatioIsAJudgement: 1.05 is a CHOICE, not a measurement (product-owner decision, docs/specs/delivery-gates/ CQ-2). It is about 20 kB gzip on the entry graph — room for an ordinary feature without a conversation, and not room for a library. There is no evidence behind the number; it is the smallest margin that does not make the gate fire on routine work.
raisedBecause: Raised on the product owner's instruction (2026-09-25). The 2026-09-16 headroom was spent and the links-and-labels epic (ADR-0159) was the 4.39 kB that tipped it: main measured 434.82 kB against a 437.00 kB budget with 2.18 kB left, and the epic takes the entry graph to 439.21 kB. Measured rather than assumed — the entry graph's package set is IDENTICAL across the two builds (26 either side, nothing new, nothing gone), and 4.29 of the 4.39 kB is the statically-imported `paint` chunk, which now carries the shared row-text layout and the track split, so the growth is application code, which is what `headroomRatio` exists to admit. Each budget is the smallest whole kB at or above floor × 1.05, the rule the earlier numbers were derived by; re-deriving moves the entry graph to 457 kB and the CSS to 17 kB (main's CSS grew 15433 → 15779 since the last floor), and leaves the lazy-chunk ceiling at 132 kB.
